description: Header file declaring functions related to component management such as setting parameters, adding/removing instances, and getting parameter values in a C project, with included licensing information.

methods.name: component_set_bool
methods.description: Sets a boolean parameter for a specified component over a bus context.

methods.name: component_set_enable
methods.description: Enables or disables a component via bus.

methods.name: component_set_str_param
methods.description: Sets a string parameter for a component.

methods.name: component_set_params
methods.description: Sets multiple parameters for a component using an array of variable structures.

methods.name: component_get_path_instance
methods.description: Retrieves the instance path of a component based on a query.

methods.name: component_add_instance
methods.description: Adds a new component instance at a specified object path.

methods.name: component_del_instance
methods.description: Deletes a component instance at a specified object path.

methods.name: component_get_param
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter value from a component.

methods.name: component_add_string_to_csv
methods.description: Appends a string value to a CSV parameter of a component.

methods.name: component_remove_string_from_csv
methods.description: Removes a string value from a CSV parameter of a component.
